subject: prd/implement-now
statement: Before claiming a directly selected issue, the executor shall compile the intake through the current native task requirements codec, bind it to a canonical issue snapshot and provider-qualified identity, and persist an immutable, digest-addressed contract in shared Git evidence. Retries of the same contract shall retain one task, claim, branch, and proposal identity. An existing different native capsule or changed intake/source shall stop with an explicit conflict rather than silently replacing an admitted contract.
rationale: ordinary issue text is mutable and is not a frozen execution authority
fit_criterion: restart and fresh-clone fixtures reproduce identical contract/task identities; cross-provider identity, changed title/body/cited comments/dependencies/intake, conflicting capsules, and failed persistence refuse claim; no synthetic plan or native model choice appears in portable requirements
